messages:
alyssa: RFC follow-up: proposing a 'diffuse fallback' pattern. Instead of failing over to one backup variant, disperse small traffic fractions across multiple older/cheaper variants + local degraded mode to avoid single-point quality cliffs.

samir: Sounds useful. Tradeoffs: router complexity and more telemetry. We'll need a policy engine and cost throttle per-tenant.

ben: Platform should own the DeploymentSpec field; router subscribes. e.g. fallbackPolicy.mode=diffuse, cost_budget_cents_per_min=200, variants=[v1-quant,v0,local-cpu].

marta: Ops: ensure immediate abort/rollback path. We must emit audit events on weight changes and per-variant metrics for paging.

deploy-bot: :information_source: canary started id=cnr-17486 service=text-gen baseline=v2 window=15m

alyssa: Architecture: proposal for a fallback-broker that ingests latency/error/quality telemetry, computes weight deltas, and publishes compact pubsub messages to router caches. Keeps decision off hot path and enables simulation.

samir: Algorithm sketch: slow proportional ramps with reservoir counters + exponential backoff. Enforce quality and cost budgets.

ben: Require a "quality_signal" in telemetry contract; provide a callback hook for custom scoring.

marta: Sticky session concern: support session affinity tokens for N requests to keep KV caches warm. Also document eviction on variant retire.

alyssa: Debugging endpoint idea: /rollout/explain?request_id=... returns which rule fired, broker decision, and small metric snippets.

ben: Pubsub proto: {route_id, weights[], generation, ttl} compact JSON so router can validate staleness.

marta: Add global emergency_abort flag that bypasses broker weights and is checked synchronously by router.

alyssa: I'll write an RFC addendum with interface shapes (DeploymentSpec, broker pubsub), telemetry contract (lat/err/quality/cost), fallback algorithm sketch, SLO safety checks (budget throttle, emergency abort), and a short runbook. Circulating by Friday.
